title: Joint Chiefs propose Operation Northwoods

tellings.quote: him this Operation Northwoods, you know,

plain: In 1962 the Joint Chiefs, the heads of the US armed forces, are said to have put a plan called Operation Northwoods in front of the president. A researcher named Dan Sheehan brings it up only in passing, without naming a source, and links it to the Air Force general Curtis LeMay, as part of his account of the pressures President John F. Kennedy faced.
